name: Dissonance
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration single performance
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The victim suffers a –1 penalty to his next Perform check.
